scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && export PORT="${PORT:-3000}" && export GEODATADIR="${GEODATADIR:-$(node -e 'const path=require("path");const p=require.resolve("geoip-lite/package.json");process.stdout.write(path.join(path.dirname(p),"data"))')}" && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.start: ROOT_DIR="$(cd ../.. && pwd)" && export GEODATADIR="${GEODATADIR:-$(find "$ROOT_DIR/node_modules/.pnpm" -type d -path '*/node_modules/geoip-lite/data' -print -quit)}" && echo "GEODATADIR=$GEODATADIR" && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
